quotes.name: Denise Carter
quotes.quote: When storefronts go quiet, families go next—so we're taking the Stabilization Fund to where the need is moving.

quotes.name: Avery Santana
quotes.quote: Nine months in, we're proving that relief without bureaucracy keeps neighbors in their neighborhoods.

quotes.name: Brenda Okoro
quotes.quote: Nine months in, the Fund's design is holding—targeted relief that flows to tenants before displacement does.

quotes.name: Marcus Webb
quotes.quote: Seventy-nine households stabilized means seventy-nine Oakland families with checks in hand before the displacement notices arrive—every dollar moving with compliance that passes the Finance Committee's scrutiny.
